heading:
Tenuta di Forte
Sorgnano
paragraphs: Our home for the weekend is a Lombard castle that has stood for over a thousand years, crowning a hilltop above the Tuderte valley in central Umbria. Honey-coloured stone, vaulted halls, olive groves and vineyards stretch as far as the eye can see.
The estate sits between Todi, Spoleto and the wine country of Montefalco — suspended, as they like to say, somewhere between earth and sky.
